reference.text: She was proceeding directly to her favourite walk, when the recollection of Mr. Darcy’s sometimes coming there stopped her, and instead of entering the park, she turned up the lane which led her farther from the turnpike road.

underlines.text: walking two or three times along that part of the lane

reference.text: The park paling was still the boundary on one side, and she soon passed one of the gates into the ground.
